name: silvershop/address-lookup
description: Checkout address autocomplete for SilverShop (CMS 6): a server-side lookup service behind a per-country provider seam (postcode+number lookup / typeahead suggest / validation). Bundles three free, keyless providers — PDOK (NL), OpenPLZ (DE/AT/CH/LI) and Zippopotam (global postcode→city) — so NL + DACH autofill out of the box. Builds on silvershop/address-formats; paid providers (MyParcel, Pro6PP, Loqate) ship as satellite add-ons.

suggest.silvershop/cookieconsent: Lets a (future, gated) provider require a consent category before the lookup runs; the three bundled providers are functional/necessary and need no gate.
suggest.silvershop/address-lookup-myparcel: Satellite: MyParcel address provider (NL postcode + BE + generic + validate), reusing the existing SS_MYPARCEL_API_KEY.
suggest.silvershop/address-lookup-loqate: Satellite: Loqate provider (global street-level, paid key).
